name: Mary CONNOLE

facts.label: PA death certificate file no.
facts.value: 1928 #5835? (last digit unclear; indexed "Hefferman, Mary", W-Barre, May 1)

bioAdditions: The 1928 state death index lists "Hefferman, Mary; 5835[3?]; W-Barre; May 1" (S1), confirming Dwyer's date. In 1900 she gave her birth as November 1850 in New York and said she had borne 11 children, 10 then living (S2).
